tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag med dbang phyug sku dang gnyis med cing*// bde chen 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs sprin 'phro ba// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku// 'khor 'das stong par mdzad pa'i thugs rje yis// gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' lta bur thams cad thogs med cing*// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul lus dang ldan// thugs dam dbang gis sgrub la brtser dgongs pa// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes pa// srid pa'i 'khor lo ma lus gcod pa'i phyir// thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa// rgyal gnyis rdo rje'i zhabs la dad pas 'dud// lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs thams cad dang*// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po dang*// gsang dang gsang rab gsang chen bla med kyi// mchod pa'i sprin chen rgya mtsho dag gis mchod// bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*// chags dang zhe sdang rnam par rmongs sems kyis// srid pa nyam ngar sdig pa ci bgyis pa// da nas sdig pa thams cad rab tu bshags// rdzogs sangs rgyas mgon byang chub sems dpa' mchog /'phags pa rnams kyis dge ba gang bgyis pa// de dag bla med byang chub 'bras thob bar// ma lus pa la rtag tu rjes yi rang*// rdzogs sangs rin chen rang gi sems gnas dang*// rtog pa'i drwa ba rab dral dam pa'i chos// sa dbang tshogs dang brtul zhugs dge 'dun la// rab tu dad pas bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rgyal dang rgyal nyid legs skyes de dag la// kun nas kun tu bdag nyid bdag gis dbul// sems dpa' mchog gis bdag ni yongs bzhes shig

/dad pas bdag nyid khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi// glo bur nyon mongs tshogs kyis gdung ba yis// bskyod pa'i skye bo mtha' dag bsgral bya'i phyir// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sngags rnams bshad pa ru// sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag gsol lo// mchog tu mi dge ba ni rab bcom pas// bdud kyi skye rga na dang 'chi las grol// mya ngan 'da' bzhed gyur pa spang bar ni// sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag gsol lo// sangs rgyas 'jig rten gang byung la// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar// de ring nyid du sems bskyed do// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// de bzhin brtan por gzung bar bgyi// ji ltar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis// sngon gyi bde gshegs grangs med la// thugs bskyed dam tshig dpag med dag /'tshang rgya bar du ma btang ltar// bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar// lus srog ltos pa med par yang*// bslab 'di mgon bzhin bsrung la gnas// ye shes thugs kyis dgongs su gsol// rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pa// rtag tu brten zhing spyad par bya// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dag /rtag tu mi phyed brtul zhugs bzung*// rgyal bas dgongs te gsungs pa yi// dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bar bgyi// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi sogs// rig sngags 'chang kun mi 'da' ltar// deng nas bla med byang chub bar// bdag gis tshul bzhin bsrung bar bgyi// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zla rer bcu phrag gnyis po dang*// bco lnga la ni rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bgyi// sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs// 'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing*// mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// gus pas bsnyen bkur mchod par bgyi// bdag gis sems can thams cad la// brnyas pa nyid du mi bgyid do// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gong bar mi bgyi'o// bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid shog

/skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che ldan bla ma la dad cing*// 'khor lo bde mchog dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*// zab cing rgya che'i chos ni rtogs pa dang*// go ku shu kra la sogs rtag za zhing*// mthar thug theg chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /deng nas byang chub snying por mchis bar du// bcom ldan bde gshegs kun tu bzang po dang*// gsang ba'i theg pa dbyer med rmad byung dang*// mi 'bral tshul bzhin rtag tu sgrub par shog /sgrub mchog 'di la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// tshe 'di la sogs skye ba bdun bar du// dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo chen po yi// zhabs rdul ze'u 'bru spyi gtsug gnas par shog /gang tshe 'gro ba'i mgon la blta ba dang*// phyir zhing cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang*// bcom ldan bde gshegs thugs kyi bdag pos ni// thams cad sgrib med sa ler mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa yi// sems can ma lus byang chub dgod pa'i phyir// thub pa'i dbang po'i spyod pa ji lta bar// bdag gi spyod pa'ang de dang 'dra bar shog /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// bdag bde dge bas de kun de thob shog /tshe rabs kun tu sgo gsum rin chen dang*// bum bzang dpag bsam ba sogs lta bur shog /mgon po kun mkhyen thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang*// sgrub pa mchog la rtse gcig sbyangs pa yis// bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub mchog thob nas// sems can thams cad smin pa'i mthu ldan shog /dbang dang mngon shes so sor rig pa dang*// gzungs dang rnam par thar pa'i sgo rtogs nas// nam mkha'i mkha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs bgrod par shog /bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yis// dam bcas bsrung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// thugs dam bzhin du rtag bsrung dngos grub ni// rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la stsol bar shog

/'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog rgyal mtshan bdug spos thogs nas kyang*// rol mo glu dang sgra snyan tshogs mchod nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /skad cig de la snang ba gsum thob nas// gsal dang rtags snang rang gi rigs rtogs te// dur khrod la sogs rgyal nyid sa thob nas// tstshandho la sogs sa la bgrod par shog /shin tu rnam par dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas rnam par grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag po yi// sras kyi dbang po nyid du bdag gyur cig /sa gsum mthar phyin gsum phrag gsum gnas gyur// shes brgyad gyur pas ye shes lngar gyur te// ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i// chos sku byang chub snying po thob par shog /chos dbyings las byung nam mkha'i mtshan nyid 'dra// thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i bdag /sems dpa' rdo rje thugs kyi bdag po ru// rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bdag gyur cig /dngos grub ma lus pa ni kun gyi bdag /dbang phyug chen po lha yi lhar gyur pa// stug po'i rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur dam pa nyid du bdag gyur cig /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes pas// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su rab chags la// 'dod chags me kun rang bzhin rnam dag pas// gsung gi dbang phyug nyid du bdag gyur cig /nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid lhun gyis grub// yon tan yid bzhin rgya chen mkha' 'dra bas// gdul bya rdzogs sangs nyid du re skong ba// khyab bdag rdo rje nyi mar bdag gyur cig /phrag dog dag pas bya ba grub brnyes shing*// phrin las rgya mtshos gdul bya dpag med rnams// grub mchog phyag rgya che la dgod mdzad pa'i// bde gshegs gdon mi za bar bdag gyur cig /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo'i skur grub nas// nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i mthu stobs kyis// 'khor 'das ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du shog

/dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa slob dpon bhu ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// jo bo rje dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o/// /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
